svg.title: DreamCarve phase 4 wireframe: V-Carve and Inlay editors
svg.text: 06 · Operation editor, V-Carve with clearing passes (capabilities 68, 70). The Inlay editor shares the Clearing group.
Cut before the V-bit, largest tool first; each is its own tool run.
next smaller end mill is picked
deepest cut 2.5 mm · flat floor, cleared by T1 then T2
⚠ clearing_not_descending would show here if T2 were above T1
Mirrored in place about the design's centre line;
On Female: Margin, Outline rounding and Cut-out are hidden;
